text.title: EF Core Data Layer Procedure
text.summary: 7-step procedure to apply the EF Core data-layer methodology end-to-end, from the DbContext boundary to the reviewed migration. Each step names the rules it satisfies.

step.name: scope-dbcontext
step.action: Create one `DbContext` per bounded context (not per service). Register as `Scoped`. Add `optionsBuilder.AddInterceptors(...)` for the audit interceptor.

step.name: design-entities
step.action: Define each POCO with `private set` properties, a private parameterless constructor for EF materialization, and collections exposed as `IReadOnlyCollection<T>` over a backing field initialised at construction. Invariants live in the public constructor and the mutating methods (`entity-private-setters`).
step.decision-gate: If the entity carries data annotations, FAIL and move them to the configuration class.

step.name: add-entity-configurations
step.action: For each entity create `Data/Configurations/<Entity>Configuration.cs` implementing `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>`. `OnModelCreating` calls `modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(AppDbContext).Assembly)` — and nothing else.
step.decision-gate: If `OnModelCreating` contains inline `builder.Entity<T>()` calls, refactor per `entity-config-per-entity` rule.

step.name: add-repositories-with-asnotracking
step.action: Implement repositories that materialise results before returning: list methods return `PagedResult<TDto>` built from `AsNoTracking()` + projection + `Skip/Take`, with a `CancellationToken` threaded to every EF call (`no-iqueryable-return`, `asnotracking-on-reads`). Bulk paths call `ExecuteUpdateAsync`/`ExecuteDeleteAsync`. Writes call `SaveChangesAsync(ct)` inside the repository.
step.decision-gate: If a repository method returns `IQueryable<T>`, fail per `no-iqueryable-return` rule.

step.name: audit-multi-collection-includes
step.action: For every query whose `.Include()` chain covers ≥ 2 collection navigations, append `.AsSplitQuery()` and note in a comment why it is split (`splitquery-multi-include`). Check the generated plan for row multiplication.
step.decision-gate: If the query still shows Cartesian row counts in the plan, refactor to an explicit projection with sub-queries.

step.name: add-audit-interceptor-and-concurrency-tokens
step.input: Aggregate root list, audit field policy
step.action: Add `[Timestamp]`/`xmin` to every aggregate root. Implement `SaveChangesInterceptor` that fills `CreatedAt`/`UpdatedAt`/`UpdatedBy` on entities implementing `IAuditable`.
step.decision-gate: If any aggregate lacks a concurrency token, BLOCK per `concurrency-token-on-aggregates` rule.

step.name: generate-and-review-migration
step.action: Run `dotnet ef migrations add <VerbPrefix>` (`AddOrdersTable`, `AlterOrderAddCarrier`). Run `dotnet ef migrations script` to emit SQL for review and diff it against the last release. Block destructive operations behind an explicit human checkpoint. Never edit or rename a migration that is already on the deploy branch — correct it with a new one (`append-only-migrations`).
step.decision-gate: If migration SQL contains `DROP COLUMN`/`DROP TABLE` and no human approval is logged, BLOCK per `migration-sql-review` rule. If the diff touches an already-merged migration file, BLOCK per `append-only-migrations` rule.
